home.title: Calculators that show their working
home.lede: Get the answer, see the steps that produced it, and check the source behind the formula. No sign-up, no clutter, and your numbers never leave your device.

principles.liveBody: Every calculator starts with realistic defaults and updates the moment you change a value. There is no Calculate button to hunt for.
principles.citedBody: Each page names the standard, study or official publication its formula comes from, with the date it was checked.
principles.privateBody: Calculations happen in your browser. Salary, loan and health figures are never sent to us or anyone else.
principles.shareBody: The page address carries your inputs, so a bookmarked or shared link reopens the exact same result.

home.comingBody: The first calculators are being built and checked against their sources. Each one is published only when its formula, tests and explanation are complete.

intro.finance: Work out loan and mortgage payments, see how savings and investments grow, and check what a rate or a fee really costs. Every finance calculator shows the formula it uses, the steps with your numbers, and the official or textbook source behind it. Amounts are calculated in exact cents, and nothing you type leaves your device.
intro.math: Percentages, fractions, ratios, averages and a full scientific calculator, each showing the working step by step. These tools are built for checking homework, invoices and everyday sums: type in your numbers, see the answer immediately, and see exactly how it was reached.
intro.health: Body measurements and fitness estimates based on published, validated formulas such as the WHO BMI classification. Each page explains who a formula was tested on and where it can mislead, so you can read the number in context. These are educational estimates, not medical advice.
intro.date-time: Count the days, weeks and months between dates, work out an exact age, or add time to a date. Calculations run on calendar dates, so time zones and daylight-saving changes can't shift a result by a day.
intro.conversion: Convert lengths, weights, volumes, temperatures and more using exact factors defined by international standards. Each converter states the factor it uses and whether it's exact by definition or rounded.
intro.education: Grade point averages and grade calculations with the scale written out, so you can match it to your school's own rules. Courses, credits and weightings are all editable.
intro.everyday: Quick, practical calculators for tips, bills and shopping, with the arithmetic shown so you can trust the split.
